title: NP-Hard Problem
statementMd:
Recently, Pari and Arya did some research about NP-Hard problems and they found the minimum vertex cover problem very interesting.

Suppose the graph $*G*$ is given. Subset $*A*$ of its vertices is called a vertex cover of this graph, if for each edge $*uv*$ there is at least one endpoint of it in this set, i.e. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/01df7772bf62e4ead52b462423b3d53890cdd820.png) or ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4a270f9b8acd044f93b92f335e44798f6c60929d.png) (or both).

Pari and Arya have won a great undirected graph as an award in a team contest. Now they have to split it in two parts, but both of them want their parts of the graph to be a vertex cover.

They have agreed to give you their graph and you need to find two **disjoint** subsets of its vertices $*A*$ and $*B*$, such that both $*A*$ and $*B*$ are vertex cover or claim it's impossible. Each vertex should be given to no more than one of the friends (or you can even keep it for yourself).

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of vertices and the number of edges in the prize graph, respectively.

Each of the next $*m*$ lines contains a pair of integers $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1  ≤  *u*_{*i*},  *v*_{*i*}  ≤  *n*$), denoting an undirected edge between $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$. It's guaranteed the graph won't contain any self-loops or multiple edges.

## Output

If it's impossible to split the graph between Pari and Arya as they expect, print "`-1`" (without quotes).

If there are two disjoint sets of vertices, such that both sets are vertex cover, print their descriptions. Each description must contain two lines. The first line contains a single integer $*k*$ denoting the number of vertices in that vertex cover, and the second line contains $*k*$ integers — the indices of vertices. Note that because of $*m* ≥ 1$, vertex cover cannot be empty.

## Note

In the first sample, you can give the vertex number $2$ to Arya and vertices numbered $1$ and $3$ to Pari and keep vertex number $4$ for yourself (or give it someone, if you wish).

In the second sample, there is no way to satisfy both Pari and Arya.
statementZhMd:
最近，Pari 和 Arya 对 NP-Hard 问题进行了一些研究，他们发现最小顶点覆盖问题非常有趣。

假设给定图 $*G*$。如果对于图中的每条边 $*uv*$，它的至少一个端点属于顶点集合 $*A*$，也就是说满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/01df7772bf62e4ead52b462423b3d53890cdd820.png) 或 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4a270f9b8acd044f93b92f335e44798f6c60929d.png)（或两者都满足），则称图中的顶点子集 $*A*$ 是该图的顶点覆盖。

Pari 和 Arya 在一次团队竞赛中赢得了一张很大的无向图作为奖励。现在他们需要将这张图分成两部分，但他们都希望自己得到的那部分图是一个顶点覆盖。

他们同意把图交给你，你需要找到两个**不相交**的顶点子集 $*A*$ 和 $*B*$，使得 $*A*$ 和 $*B*$ 都是顶点覆盖，或者判定这是不可能的。每个顶点至多分配给其中一人（当然，你也可以把它留给自己）。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100 000$）——奖励图中的顶点数和边数。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*u*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$（$1  ≤  *u*_{*i*},  *v*_{*i*}  ≤  *n*$），表示一条连接 $*u*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$ 的无向边。保证图中不包含自环或重边。

## 输出格式

如果无法按照 Pari 和 Arya 的要求分割图，输出 `-1`（不含引号）。

如果存在两个不相交的顶点集合，使得两个集合都是顶点覆盖，则输出它们的描述。每个描述包含两行。第一行包含一个整数 $*k*$，表示该顶点覆盖中的顶点数；第二行包含 $*k*$ 个整数，表示这些顶点的编号。注意，由于 $*m* ≥ 1$，顶点覆盖不可能为空。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，你可以将编号为 $2$ 的顶点分给 Arya，将编号为 $1$ 和 $3$ 的顶点分给 Pari，并将编号为 $4$ 的顶点留给自己（当然，如果愿意，也可以把它分给其中一人）。

在第二个样例中，没有办法同时满足 Pari 和 Arya 的要求。
